verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents an automated hire-and-onboard flow running from offer letter to day one, and employee self-service where staff enter their own personal, direct deposit and tax info online or in the app. Together these cover bank details and tax withholding (W-4-type) data collected before start. missing for 10: explicit I-9 collection or verification, explicit naming of the W-4 form, detail on sending the onboarding invite to the new hire, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: Hire and onboard in one professional flow. From offer letter to day one, everything can be automated so new hires are ready to go.
Your team can access their pay stubs and W-2s and enter their personal, direct deposit, and tax info online or in app.
